cause_description: More or fewer transactions at similar rates
description: More or fewer transactions at similar rates
computation: (Δ transaction count) × prior-month average transaction value, for the remaining transactions after account-level and one-time effects are claimed.

cause_description: The same number of transactions at a different average value.
description: The same number of transactions at a different average value.
computation: to_txn_count × (to_avg_value − from_avg_value), net of fee-rate and billable-day effects on recurring groups so the same dollars are not counted twice.

cause_description: Non-recurring items such as syndicate allocations, new issues, referrals
description: Non-recurring items such as syndicate allocations, new issues, referrals
computation: Change in revenue tagged one-time (from file_key and trade_description) between the two months.

cause_description: Revenue moving into or out of credited status
description: Revenue moving into or out of credited status
computation: Change in non-credited revenue for the group (e.g. a household crossing the minimum-household threshold moves revenue from credited to non-credited). Contribution = −(Δ non-credited).

cause_description: Revenue excluded because it processed more than 90 days after the trade
description: Revenue excluded because it processed more than 90 days after the trade
computation: Change in revenue failing the 90-day rule (proc_dt − trade_dt > 90). Contribution = −(Δ late-excluded).

cause_description: Revenue moving into or out of an excluded state (e.g. a deleted booking)
description: Revenue moving into or out of an excluded state (e.g. a deleted booking)
computation: Change in revenue carrying an excluding reason code (e.g. 9X deleted) between the two months. Contribution = −(Δ excluded).

cause_description: Quarterly or periodic billing landing in one month but not the other
description: Quarterly or periodic billing landing in one month but not the other
computation: Revenue for a group present in one month's billing cycle and absent the other, not already claimed by One-Time.

cause_description: Change in the effective fee rate charged
description: Change in the effective fee rate charged
computation: Prior-month asset proxy × (this month's avg rate − last month's), in bps.
Change in Σ discount amount and in the count of discounted transactions.

cause_description: A different number of billing days between the two months
description: A different number of billing days between the two months
computation: Recurring/fee-based revenue × (Δ billable days ÷ prior billable days). Derived from a business-day calendar.

cause_description: The residual shift between products at different rates
description: The residual shift between products at different rates
computation: Whatever remains after all named drivers are attributed. A large value here means a driver may be missing.

cause_description: Revenue from accounts in recurring product lines (Managed, Trails) that began billing after a confirmed quiet period
description: Revenue from accounts in recurring product lines (Managed, Trails) that began billing after a confirmed quiet period
computation: Accounts in recurring product lines with no activity for ACCOUNT_ABSENCE_MONTHS consecutive loaded months (default 2) that then appear, evaluated at advisor level so a mere product switch is not miscounted. Transactional product lines never emit this driver — intermittent trading there is routine. Contribution = Σ credited revenue of those accounts.

cause_description: Revenue lost from accounts in recurring product lines with no billing activity for consecutive months
description: Revenue lost from accounts in recurring product lines with no billing activity for consecutive months
computation: Mirror of New Account: accounts in recurring product lines billing in the from-month and then quiet for ACCOUNT_ABSENCE_MONTHS consecutive loaded months (default 2). A single quiet month is ordinary intermittency, not a lost account. Contribution = −(their prior-month credited revenue).
Change in the sum of negative credited amounts between the months.

description: Movement in asset values (not yet sourced — shown as illustrative)
computation: Requires an index-return feed not currently available. Modelled, flagged, contributes $0 until data is supplied.

cause_description: Client inflows and outflows (not yet sourced — shown as illustrative)
description: Client inflows and outflows (not yet sourced — shown as illustrative)
computation: Requires a flows feed (current source stops Jan 2026). Modelled, flagged, contributes $0 until data is supplied.

cause_description: Recurring-line account movement the loaded data cannot classify — too few loaded months before or after this transition to apply the account-presence test
description: Recurring-line account movement the loaded data cannot classify — too few loaded months before or after this transition to apply the account-presence test
computation: At the edges of the loaded range (not enough months before the first transition / after the last), New/Lost Account cannot be confirmed. Contribution = Σ credited revenue of unconfirmable recurring-line accounts present in only one of the two months, signed. Checked against total gross driver movement as a build-time warning. Derived, never narrated as a business event.
